evals.name: Scrape a webpage into markdown
prompts: Get me the full content of https://docs.firecrawl.dev/introduction as clean markdown so I can read it.
judges: The agent returns readable markdown content extracted from the Firecrawl introduction page.

evals.name: Search the web for recent news
prompts: What are the latest developments in LLM context window sizes? Search the web and give me a summary with sources.
judges: The agent returns ranked web search results with excerpts and URLs about recent LLM context window advancements.

evals.name: Discover URLs on a website
prompts: List all the URLs available under https://www.firecrawl.dev without downloading their content — I just need the site map.
judges: The agent returns a list of URLs discovered under firecrawl.dev without fetching full page content.

evals.name: Look up a protein's function and location
prompts: Where is the protein TP53 located in the cell, and what does it do according to UniProt?
judges: The agent returns curated subcellular location, function, and GO terms for TP53 from UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot.

evals.name: Crawl a documentation site
prompts: Crawl https://docs.firecrawl.dev up to 20 pages and return the markdown content of each page so I can build a local knowledge base.
judges: The agent starts and completes a crawl job returning markdown content from multiple pages under docs.firecrawl.dev.

evals.name: Create a page change monitor
prompts: Set up a monitor that checks https://openai.com/news every day and alerts me if any new announcements appear.
judges: The agent creates a monitor targeting the OpenAI news page on a daily schedule and returns the monitor ID or confirmation.

evals.name: Run an immediate monitor check
prompts: I have a monitor with ID mon_abc123. Run it right now outside its normal schedule so I can see the latest diff immediately.
judges: The agent queues an immediate check for the specified monitor and returns the queued check details.

evals.name: Search scientific papers on a topic
prompts: Find recent research papers about CRISPR off-target effects from the last two years, ranked by relevance.
judges: The agent returns a list of paper results with titles, abstracts, and source identifiers related to CRISPR off-target effects.

evals.name: List recent monitor check history
prompts: Show me the last 10 checks for monitor ID mon_abc123, including any that had errors.
judges: The agent returns a list of up to 10 historical check summaries for the specified monitor with their statuses.

evals.name: Check current Firecrawl credit balance
prompts: How many Firecrawl credits do I have left in my current billing period?
judges: The agent returns the current remaining credit balance for the authenticated Firecrawl account.

evals.name: List all links on docs index page
prompts: Can you get me all the links that appear on https://docs.python.org/3/index.html? I want to see every URL that page points to.
judges: The agent returns a list of absolute URLs found on the Python 3 docs index page, without including the page's full text content.
